lines: Your longing, so very precious to me
won't go to waste — the world keeps turning
And my feelings, small as they are,
That impulse — it's just like love, isn't it
Repeating, like it did someday before
That scene comes back to life
That reaction — it seems unreal, doesn't it
Ah, a love like plastic (love, love...)
Rhythm, rhythm, rhythm, rhythm, rhythm, rhythm
